title: AI Persona Steering System
summary: This repository implements an AI persona steering system for large language models. It provides tools for developing, evaluating, and applying distinct personas to influence model behavior in conversational and interactive applications. Users can interact with persona-steered chat interfaces, explore dynamic D&D playground scenarios, and analyze the internal workings of persona activations. The system aims to enable fine-grained control over AI responses through persona-driven steering vectors.

nodes.label: End-User / Client App
nodes.title: End-User / Client Application
nodes.description: An external user or application interacting with the persona-steered AI services via API endpoints, such as chat interfaces or interactive playgrounds.

nodes.label: Developer / Researcher
nodes.title: Developer / Researcher

nodes.description: A user responsible for managing the application's lifecycle, monitoring health, and orchestrating system resources, ensuring stable and efficient operation.

nodes.label: Language Model Backend
nodes.title: Underlying LLM Service

nodes.label: External Evaluation Services

nodes.description: Centralized storage for persona vectors, trait bundles, calibration data, and other structured information defining personas and their properties.

groups.label: User Interfaces & API Gateway
groups.title: User Interfaces & API Gateway

groups.label: Persona Development & Evaluation
groups.title: Persona Development & Evaluation
groups.description: This group encompasses the comprehensive suite of tools and workflows for researchers and developers to create, evaluate, and refine AI personas and their steering vectors, including experimentation, data generation, and analysis.

groups.label: Core AI Logic, Models & Data
groups.title: Core AI Logic, Models & Data
